title: Managed Re-Installation Fee on Certificate Renewal
content:
## Notice: managed re-installation fee on SSL/TLS Certificates renewals

Harborline support may have installed an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription's certificate as a managed installation on the customer's server. A support renewal of such a subscription carries a managed re-installation fee, which covers the automatic reissues of the renewed year. A support renewal is a one-year renewal booked by Harborline support during a conversation. The fee is added to the support renewal amount.

### What shows that Harborline support installed the certificate

The evidence is the subscription's certificate billing history. The lines that count are the installation lines on the subscription that no refund line of charge type installation reverses. An installation line that was later refunded no longer counts.

### Fee schedule

| Installation lines that still stand | Managed re-installation fee |
|---|---|
| two or more | USD 20.00 |
| exactly one | USD 12.00 |
| none | no managed re-installation fee |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- **Three installation lines, one of them refunded.** Two lines still stand, so the fee is USD 20.00.
- **Two installation lines, both refunded.** No line stands, so no managed re-installation fee applies.
- **One installation line, not refunded.** The fee is USD 12.00.

The fee is a fixed amount for the renewal. It does not grow with the number of lines above two.
